target.statement: Specialist model trained on 10k task-specific instances achieves 98.11% accuracy on the Yelp sentiment classification task (LLaMA-7B).

compute.basis: Fine-tuning LLaMA-7B for 3 epochs on 10k examples requires GPU memory and hours of compute; CPU-only training would be impractically slow.

blockers: Requires fine-tuning a 7B parameter LLM, which is not feasible on a CPU-only laptop within a few hours.
The exact training data (10k task-specific instances for Yelp) may not be directly provided in the repository; it likely needs to be constructed from SuperNI and Yelp datasets.
The repository may not include preprocessed data or training scripts for this specific experiment.
title: Specialist or Generalist? Instruction Tuning for Specific NLP Tasks
